text: What if every breath doubled your gum bubble?
formula: Title question word for word (STANDARD 1.3); the rate is in the title (0.13). Diameter after breath n: D = 5 cm x 2^n (start: a normal 5 cm bubble at breath 0).

text: You want one good bubble. The record is fifty-one centimetres.
formula: Opening wish (0.14) + LEAN / reality first (2.11): Guinness World Records 'Largest bubblegum bubble blown': 50.8 cm (20 in) diameter, Chad Fell, Winston County, Alabama, 24 April 2004 - still unbeaten (GWR news, Oct 2025). Breath 4: 5 x 2^4 = 80 cm > 50.8 cm (breath 3 = 40 cm < 50.8).

text: But yours never pops. Every breath doubles it.
formula: SNAPBACK. Breath 1 = 10 cm, 2 = 20 cm, 3 = 40 cm (knocks your coffee off the paper stack), 4 = 80 cm (world record beaten, bumps Mittens onto your shoulder), 5 = 1.6 m (wider than a 1.4 m office desk: shoves it away).

text: Breath six. Straight through the ceiling.
formula: Breath 6: 5 cm x 64 = 3.2 m > a typical 2.7 m office ceiling (breath 5 = 1.6 m fits).

text: Your breath is warm. Warm air rises. So up you go.
formula: Why it lifts (like a hot-air balloon): air density rho = 1.204 kg/m3 at 20 C; breath at 37 C: 1.204 x 293.15/310.15 = 1.138 kg/m3 -> lift 0.066 kg per m3. Breath 8: D = 12.8 m, V = pi/6 x 12.8^3 = 1,098 m3 -> lift 72 kg, enough for a 70 kg person (gum mass ignored - the what-if). Breath 9: 8,780 m3 -> 580 kg.

text: Breath eleven. Taller than the Statue of Liberty.
formula: Breath 11: 5 cm x 2048 = 102 m > Statue of Liberty 93 m ground to torch (NPS 'Statue Statistics': 305 ft 1 in). Breath 10 = 51 m < 93.

text: Breath fifteen. Taller than the Burj Khalifa.
formula: Breath 15: 5 cm x 32,768 = 1,638 m > Burj Khalifa 828 m (breath 14 = 819 m < 828).

text: Breath eighteen. Bigger than Mount Everest.
formula: Breath 18: 5 cm x 262,144 = 13.1 km > Everest 8,849 m above sea level (breath 17 = 6.55 km < 8.85).

text: Breath twenty-one. It pokes out into space.
formula: Breath 21: 5 cm x 2,097,152 = 104.9 km > the Karman line, 100 km, the usual edge of space (breath 20 = 52 km).

text: Don't ask where the air comes from.
formula: Joke set up by the picture: you are in space and still blowing.
Breath 27: 6,711 km > the Moon, 3,474.8 km wide (breath 26 = 3,355 km). Breath 28: 5 cm x 2^28 = 13,422 km > Earth's diameter 12,742 km (breath 27 = 6,711 km).
Breath 32: 5 cm x 2^32 = 214,748 km > Jupiter's equatorial diameter 139,820 km (breath 31 = 107,374 km).

text: Breath thirty-five. Bigger than the Sun.
formula: Breath 35: 5 cm x 2^35 = 1,717,987 km > the Sun's diameter 1,392,700 km (breath 34 = 858,993 km).

text: You could stop blowing. You don't.
formula: Narrator blames the hero (2.6), set up by 'every breath doubles it'.

text: Breath forty-three. Earth's whole orbit fits inside.
formula: Breath 43: 5 cm x 2^43 = 4.398e11 m = 439.8 million km > the diameter of Earth's orbit, 2 AU = 2 x 149.6 = 299.2 million km (breath 42 = 219.9 million km). Counter keeps doubling to breath 47 on the last frame (7.04 billion km).
Callback ending (pays off the wish in n1), said while it keeps growing.

text: What's the biggest bubble you've ever blown?
formula: Closing question, specific and answerable from the viewer's own life (STANDARD 1.9).
